trap_jaw.name: Trap-jaw
trap_jaw.desc: Spring-loaded mandibles snap shut faster than a blink.

thick_cuticle.name: Thick Cuticle
thick_cuticle.desc: Tougher exoskeletons shrug off bites and stings.

serrated_mandibles.name: Serrated Mandibles
serrated_mandibles.desc: Saw-toothed jaws cut through prey and leaves alike.

majors.name: Majors
majors.desc: Big-headed bruisers hatch from well-fed larvae.

iron_grip.name: Iron Grip
iron_grip.desc: Ants lock on and never let go, pinning prey for the swarm.

butchers.name: Butchers
butchers.desc: Carcasses are cut up neatly, wasting nothing.

decapitate.name: Decapitate
decapitate.desc: Soldiers aim for the neck. Grim, effective.

colossus_heads.name: Colossus Heads
colossus_heads.desc: Majors grow heads like boulders and bodies to match.

formic_spray.name: Formic Spray
formic_spray.desc: Soldiers squirt acid from their abdomens at range.

long_scent.name: Long Scent
long_scent.desc: Trail pheromones linger twice as long.

keen_antennae.name: Keen Antennae
keen_antennae.desc: Ants smell trails from further away.

loud_alarm.name: Loud Alarm
loud_alarm.desc: Alarm scent carries across the whole lawn.

royal_jelly_scent.name: Royal Command
royal_jelly_scent.desc: The Queen's scent orders carry extra weight.

fear_musk.name: Fear Musk
fear_musk.desc: A sickly stench that sends creatures scurrying.

antiseptic_glands.name: Antiseptic Glands
antiseptic_glands.desc: Metapleural secretions keep the nest clean of mould.

masking_odour.name: Masking Odour
masking_odour.desc: Trails smell of nothing to humans and cats.

acid_cloud.name: Acid Cloud
acid_cloud.desc: Massed spray leaves enemies blind and sore.

aphid_ranching.name: Aphid Ranching
aphid_ranching.desc: Herd and milk aphids for a steady honeydew supply.

efficient_crops.name: Thrifty Stomachs
efficient_crops.desc: Ants share food mouth-to-mouth with less waste.

honeydew_tending.name: Gentle Milking
honeydew_tending.desc: Better stroking technique, more honeydew per aphid.

seed_granary.name: Seed Granary
seed_granary.desc: Harvester ants collect and store seeds that never spoil.

repletes.name: Honeypot Repletes
repletes.desc: Some workers swell into living sugar jars.

leafcutter.name: Leafcutter
leafcutter.desc: Cut leaves to farm fungus in special chambers.

royal_banquet.name: Royal Banquet
royal_banquet.desc: A pampered Queen lays more eggs.

fungus_masters.name: Fungus Masters
fungus_masters.desc: Cultivated fungus crowds out wild mould.

clay_masons.name: Clay Masons
clay_masons.desc: Walls are packed with wet clay and saliva.

strong_diggers.name: Strong Diggers
strong_diggers.desc: Broader mandibles move more soil per bite.

vaulted_ceilings.name: Vaulted Ceilings
vaulted_ceilings.desc: Arched roofs let chambers span wider.

air_shafts.name: Air Shafts
air_shafts.desc: Chimney tunnels pull fresh air through the nest.

drainage.name: Drainage Channels
drainage.desc: Sloped tunnels lead rain straight to the sump.

thermal_mound.name: Thermal Mound
thermal_mound.desc: A thatched dome keeps the nest warm in winter and cool in summer.

living_bridges.name: Living Bridges
living_bridges.desc: Ants link legs to span gaps on the surface.

deep_shafts.name: Deep Shafts
deep_shafts.desc: Dig far below the frost line and the water table.

fortress_mound.name: Fortress
fortress_mound.desc: Reinforced galleries that barely ever cave in.

minims.name: Minims
minims.desc: Tiny workers that are cheap to raise and quick on their feet.

strong_backs.name: Strong Backs
strong_backs.desc: Every worker can carry a little more.

raft.name: Raft
raft.desc: When the nest floods, ants link into a floating raft.

long_lives.name: Long Lives
long_lives.desc: Workers live longer and remember more trails.

wedding_fever.name: Wedding Fever
wedding_fever.desc: Winged royals fly further and find better mates.

army_march.name: Army March
army_march.desc: Swarm across the yard in a devouring column.

brood_rush.name: Brood Rush
brood_rush.desc: The whole colony pitches in to raise brood.

hive_mind.name: Hive Mind
hive_mind.desc: Ants sense and share every trail as one creature.
